C.unit: Python str elements returned by TextIO read/readline

rules: Do not replace H and C with a shared limit or convert C into an encoded-byte limit.
Count the entire serialized document, including escapes, whitespace and any newline returned by the reader.
C counts code points in valid decoded text, not grapheme clusters or UTF-16 code units.
A TextIO without .buffer is encoded strictly as UTF-8 at hook ingress before checking H.
A hook TextIO with .buffer uses that binary buffer, bypassing its text codec.
run_decision is a TextIO API. Direct BinaryIO input is outside these supported recipes.

materialization.serializer: json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=parameter, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')); no implicit newline
materialization.hook_sized: Set prompt initially to '합성 경계 문장: '. Let O be the byte length of that serialized template and W the serialized-byte increment for one unit. Set n,r=divmod(H+delta-O,W); append unit*n+'x'*r to prompt and serialize. Thus target counts full-envelope bytes, never prompt length alone.
materialization.hook_repeat: Set prompt to '합성 경계 문장: '+unit*count and serialize with the selected ensure_ascii setting.
materialization.hook_octets: Serialize hook_template with prompt='' using ensure_ascii=False. Locate the empty prompt string by JSON-aware construction, then insert the named raw octets between its quotes without decoding or re-encoding those octets. Keep the closing quote and brace unless truncate_after_octets=true.
materialization.hook_read_cut: Construct a valid UTF-8 hook envelope whose prompt ends in U+1F642. Place the first of that scalar's four UTF-8 bytes at zero-based offset H-1 by adding ASCII x padding before it. Preserve the closing JSON quote and brace. The binary read(H+1) window then ends after the scalar's first two bytes, while the complete envelope is valid and exceeds H.
materialization.hook_scalar: Set prompt to '합성 경계 문장: '+the specified code point. For direct_text, serialize with ensure_ascii=False and retain the Python str without UTF-8 encoding. For escaped, serialize with ensure_ascii=True then encode as UTF-8.
materialization.decision_valid_sized: Serialize {'operation':'catalog','locale':'ko'} with ensure_ascii=False. Right-pad with ASCII spaces to C+delta characters BEFORE appending the selected terminator. This is valid JSON whitespace, not a new schema field.
materialization.decision_padding: Serialize {'operation':'reset','synthetic_padding':unit*count} using ensure_ascii. For target_chars instead of count, choose n,r so the entire serialized str has C+delta characters, adding ASCII x*r inside synthetic_padding. This deliberate unknown field isolates the size gate from later schema rejection.
materialization.decision_catalog: Serialize {'operation':'catalog','locale':'ko'} with ensure_ascii=False and no newline.
materialization.bom_prefix: Prefix EF BB BF to serialized bytes, or U+FEFF to a direct Python str, exactly once. A BOM inside a JSON string is not a file prefix.
materialization.append_next: Append a fresh serialized {'operation':'reset'}+'\n' only after the first row's terminator.
materialization.size_assumptions: W is the serialized increment, including escape expansion. Do not normalize Unicode. Resolve codepoint lists with chr, not UTF-8 encoding of a surrogate. Do not use eval on this file.

streams.text_no_buffer: io.StringIO(text); for valid raw input, text=raw.decode('utf-8', errors='strict')
streams.text_utf8_buffer: Fresh unread io.TextIOWrapper(io.BytesIO(raw), encoding='utf-8', errors='strict', newline='')
streams.text_sig_buffer: Fresh unread io.TextIOWrapper(io.BytesIO(raw), encoding='utf-8-sig', errors='strict', newline='')
streams.text_utf8_translate: Fresh unread io.TextIOWrapper(io.BytesIO(raw), encoding='utf-8', errors='strict', newline=None)
streams.fresh_stream_rule: Construct a separate unread stream for each case and surface. Never pre-read a TextIOWrapper or reuse its underlying buffer.

expectations.basis: Source-derived predictions, not observations or passing results.
expectations.hook_entry: run_hook returns 0; parsed stdout hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext equals the current ENTRY_GUIDANCE. No prompt echo or method application is implied.
expectations.hook_empty: run_hook returns 0 and stdout is the literal empty string. No traceback or synthetic input echo.
expectations.decision_catalog: run_decision returns 0 and emits one JSON object with status=catalog; this is metadata, not method application.
expectations.decision_schema_rejection: One JSON object with reason=invalid_decision_request; do not pin #130's field/error/expected text in this encoding fixture.
expectations.decision_oversize: One JSON object with reason=request_too_large; return 0 without dispatching the payload or consuming a subsequent request row.

decision_invalid_json.other_frozen_sha: Resolve from the integrated source before execution; neither historical branch is automatically the candidate.

expectations.decision_decode_exception: A strict TextIO decoding exception arises at read/readline before the JSON try block in both inspected revisions. Record the exception category separately; no synthetic JSON response or process exit code is predicted. This is a characterization recipe, not a new confirmed runtime defect.

cases.note: Same decoded prompt as H04, but serialized JSON exceeds H because each emoji uses 12 ASCII escape characters.
Incomplete ED 95 9C (한) before the closing JSON quote.
Invalid UTF-8 encoding of U+D800, distinct from six ASCII JSON escape characters.
The hook uses raw .buffer bytes even when a text wrapper has utf-8-sig configured.

cases.failure_layer: JSON decoding succeeds; prompt scalar UTF-8 validation rejects the lone surrogate

cases.note: Serializer emits the valid JSON pair \ud83d\ude42, not a lone surrogate.
Do not normalize three Jamo code points to precomposed 한 before measuring.

cases.failure_layer: Oversize is detected on H+1 raw bytes before any UTF-8 decoding; no adapter dispatch.
cases.read_request: H+1 bytes from the binary source; do not claim the incomplete read window is accepted UTF-8.

cases.note: The caller-supplied utf-8-sig TextIO strips the prefix before run_decision reads characters; the function itself does not strip it.
Do not UTF-8 encode this direct StringIO input. This asserts rejection of an unknown field, not general acceptance of surrogate-bearing requests.
The JSON shape is immaterial because strict decoding fails first. Do not feed a BytesIO directly to the TextIO API.

case_expansion: Expand each *_values list and streams as an independent Cartesian matrix. For each fresh variant use expected_by_delta[str(delta)] when present. Unspecified stream_mode defaults to false. IDs gain /delta=<n>/stream=<name> and any other varied parameter; record every variant without favorable reruns.
